column1: # Format: UTF-8, LF, one rule per line: kind<TAB>stem<TAB>payload...
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are skipped. Any structural error
# (unknown kind, wrong field count, empty field, a word outside the normalized
# Tatar alphabet, duplicates, an unknown override label) aborts the build. The
# SHA-256 of this file is pinned in tests/wordform_gen/test_wordform_gen.py;
#   Forces one suffix harmony instead of the surface-vowel heuristic. Used for
#   stems whose spelling does not reveal their suffix harmony (министры,
#   Possessive-family forms (noun.p1/p2/p3/p1pl/p2pl and the noun.p3.* case
#   forms built on noun.p3) attach to BASE after the regular final-consonant
#   voicing and final-ь spelling rules; plural, case, p3pl, predicative and
#   derivational forms stay on STEM. Used for lexical syncope (халык→халкы).
#   Suppletive paradigm: exactly these forms are emitted (label noun.pron) and
#   regular noun generation for the stem is suppressed (мин → минем миңа …,
#   no минләр). Verb and derivational generation still apply (минде is a real
#   Replaces the generated form for LABEL (a generator label such as
#   verb.pres.3sg or noun.p3). Overriding a person-bearing base
#   (verb.pres.3sg, noun.p3) re-derives the forms built on it (су →
#   суын/суына/суында/суыннан). An override whose label the stem never
#   emits is an error when that stem is processed.
# Simple future of the -ыр/-ер monosyllable class (the rule generates -ар/-әр
# for monosyllables, -ыр/-ер for longer stems; these are lexical exceptions,
# attested in SART and the Tatar morphology analyzer: барыр, бирер, белер,
# булыр, алыр, әйтер, калыр, килер, торыр, тулыр, йөрер).
# уку is suppletive: укы- for present/past (укый, укыды, укыган, уку) but ук-
# before the future and the negative suffixes (kaikki-attested: укар, укачак,
# укмый, укмас, укмыйча; укмады/укмаган from standard grammar). The 3sg
# overrides re-derive their person forms (укмыйм, укмадым…).
# Masdar of ю ("to wash") is юу, not the glide-spelled *юю.
